name: Interface Layer
exists_now: Live reads for projects, agents, lifecycle approvals, and timeline events
main_gap: No live cost or health dashboard and no user-facing goal submission flow.
next_validation: Dashboard creates a goal through gateway and shows the resulting project and timeline.

name: Orchestration Layer
main_gap: Routing is keyword-based and does not yet consult live control-plane policies.
next_validation: Submit goal, run ready tasks, and inspect durable result timeline.

name: Control Plane
exists_now: Seeded agents, capabilities, permissions, and policies
main_gap: Organization changes are still limited and no LLM belongs inside this layer.
next_validation: Create or update an agent in state, then verify control-plane world view.

name: Domain Agents Layer
exists_now: Interim OpenRouter runtime mode for deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash
main_gap: No persistent per-agent worker loop, Hermes wrapper, tool execution, or model-gateway service.
next_validation: Run a narrow division workflow with typed output, event, cost, and memory candidate.

name: Project / Workflow Layer
exists_now: Project, workspace, assignment, task, dependency, and result records
Project complexity reports and split requests
main_gap: No continuous scheduler loop or worker queue for autonomous task execution.
next_validation: Agent result updates task status/result and can be replayed through chronological events.

name: Memory & Context Layer
exists_now: Deterministic ranking and token budget enforcement
Gateway persists agent memory candidates as proposed and emits memory.candidate_created
Proposed and rejected memories are excluded from context assembly
main_gap: No human review UI, compaction, vector search, graph retrieval, or hierarchical context database.
next_validation: Approve a proposed memory candidate and verify it appears in the next task context.

name: Execution & Tooling Layer
main_gap: No tool registry, permission check before execution, sandbox, or audit trail for tool calls.
next_validation: Denied tool call fails before execution and records audit/event.

name: Data / Knowledge Layer
exists_now: Structured system facts for Synarch layer status
main_gap: No external connectors, ingestion jobs, document provenance, or loaders.
next_validation: Seed system facts into memory and verify they appear in context assembly with source metadata.

name: Observability & Governance Layer
exists_now: Events, audit logs, cost records, and trace IDs
main_gap: No OpenTelemetry instrumentation, Langfuse traces, or live cost dashboard.
next_validation: One request has the same trace ID across gateway, state, runtime, event, cost, memory, and audit.
